cards.claim: Image resizing techniques improve classification accuracy
cards.conditions: Histopathology image classification with DCNN on multiclass tumor classification (74 brain tumor types)
cards.evidence: Empirical results on multiple datasets and architectures
cards.quote: LRET consistently outperforms existing methods, yielding a substantial improvement of 15-28% in accuracy for a large-scale, multiclass tumor classification task consisting of 74 distinct brain tumor types.

cards.claim: Coupling resizing with efficient training reduces training time
cards.conditions: Histopathology image classification with multiple DCNN architectures
cards.quote: LRET not only elevates classification accuracy but also substantially reduces training times, unlocking the potential for faster model development and iteration.

cards.claim: Learned resizing preserves structural information while integrating larger image patches
cards.conditions: Histopathology image classification with multiple datasets and architectures
cards.effect: Enable seamless integration of larger patches without information loss
cards.evidence: Method design principle; empirical validation through performance gains
cards.quote: Our method, termed Learned Resizing with Efficient Training (LRET), couples efficient training techniques with image resizing to facilitate seamless integration of larger histology image patches into state-of-the-art classification models while preserving important structural information.
